instruction: Use Bonsai's native IFC authoring workflow to create a new metric IFC4 single-storey mirrored duplex with two units, A and B, sharing a central wall. Start from a blank project; no init_file inputs or reference images are provided. Save the completed model as result.ifc. The model should contain one project, one site, one building, one building storey named Duplex Level, four spaces, seven walls, one slab, two doors, four windows, six opening elements, six void relationships, and six fill relationships. Do not use building element proxies, furniture, roofs, columns, beams, stairs, or flow terminals, and keep all IfcRoot GlobalId values unique. Name the spaces A Living, A Bed, B Living, and B Bed; each space should have world-coordinate plan spans of 3.20 m by 2.90 m within about 0.10 m. Name the center separator wall Shared Wall and arrange A Living opposite B Living and A Bed opposite B Bed so the paired areas match within 0.35 m2, their X centroids match within 0.65 m, and their average Y centroid lies within 0.65 m of the Shared Wall Y centroid. Each wall should be 3.00 m high within about 0.10 m. Add A Entrance and B Entrance doors, each with OverallWidth 0.95 m, hosted in separate openings in South Wall and North Wall respectively. Add A Living Window, A Bed Window, B Living Window, and B Bed Window, each with OverallWidth 1.20 m, hosted in separate openings in West Wall, East Wall, West Wall, and East Wall respectively. Other details may vary.
